newsitem.title: CHINA: China says will repatriate Taiwan hijacker.
newsitem.headline: China says will repatriate Taiwan hijacker.

text.p: China will repatriate a Taiwanese hijacker who forced a Taiwan airliner to China earlier this month, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Xinhua quoted the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Strait, which handles ties between China and Taiwan in absence of formal links, as saying Liu Shan-chung would be repatriated to Taiwan after investigations were completed.
It did not give a date for Liu's repatriation.
Liu hijacked a Taiwan airliner to China's southeastern city of Xiamen on March 10. China returned the plane, other passengers and crew, but took Liu into custody.
"We hope that the Taiwan side will take prompt measures to repatriate hijackers, in a bid to join hands in cracking down on hijacking," Xinhua quoted an official of the association as saying.
